title: Fab-ready USB supply
prompt: Design a fabrication-ready printed circuit board: 5V from a USB connector regulated to 3.3V by a linear regulator, with input and output capacitors and a power-indicator LED with its resistor — at least five footprints. Board outline at most 40mm × 25mm, two copper layers. Declare nets VBUS, 3V3, and GND; place and route so every net's copper is fully connected. This is the fab gate: beyond a clean design-rule check, the board must survive Gerber serialization of every layer — if it can't be exported for manufacture, it doesn't pass. Output a .vcad document containing the board as a PcbBoard node.
